component: ZenDB v2.0.1 M1 synthetic authoritative-data proof
status: IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-02: the runner retains the prior logical-ID pass and now adds application-owner lost-reply and archive-failure sagas, bootstrap/self-grant audit, a post-upgrade revocation check, and a bounded collection-v1-to-v2 replay/resume fixture. Every DFX operation is bounded to 180 seconds with a 10-second kill grace and a cleanup trap. It does not invoke mops install because Mops 2.19.2 makes an unrelated compatibility request before resolving the pinned lock.
